name: PHD Rooftop Lounge
address: Dream Downtown, 355 W 16th St (12th floor), New York, NY 10011
status_note: Appears open. The Tao Group official page still lists regular Wed-Sat hours and SevenRooms VIP booking. The Rooftop Guide updated its listing Apr 27, 2026, and a New Year's Eve 2026 ticket page is live. The Tao page also shows a generic 'Closed for the Season' pop-up that doesn't name a venue; ambiguous, so the status rests on the hours listing. The hotel is now branded 'Dream Downtown, by Hyatt'.

dress.detail: The Rooftop Guide (updated Apr 2026) calls it smart casual. Alotea describes a stricter smart/elegant code. Tao Group's official page publishes no dress code.

cover.value: Not published officially. A concierge site reports cover from ~$50 at management's discretion.

getting_in.value: VIP tables and bottle service are booked ahead on SevenRooms (a deposit may be required). Otherwise it's at the door's discretion, with a heavy promoter/table culture.

subway.value: 14 St (A/C/E) / 8 Av (L), about a 3-minute walk (the hotel is on W 16th between 8th and 9th Aves)

skip_if: You want a relaxed rooftop drink: after 10pm it turns into a loud, club-style, bottle-service room.
You're on a budget: prices are steep and entry is at the door's discretion.
